title: UC-01 · Region failure of the primary node
subtitle: Fail every transaction over to the alternate region

clocks.label: Outage clock
clocks.explain: From the region failure to the first transaction committed in {drRegion}

phases.label: Pre-check
phases.explain: Checking that every node, availability group and distributed AG is healthy

phases.label: Start workload
phases.explain: An application writer commits a ledger row every 0.2 s on {primary} ({failedRegion})

phases.label: Warm-up
phases.explain: Transactions flow from {primary} to {dr} ({drRegion}) and on to every forwarder

phases.label: Region failure
phases.explain: Every VM in {failedRegion} is powered off hard - no shutdown, like losing the region

phases.label: Detection
phases.explain: {dr} in {drRegion} notices it has lost the primary

phases.label: Forced failover
phases.explain: Promoting {dr} to primary: transactions not yet replicated are accepted as lost

phases.label: First write
phases.explain: Proving {drRegion} accepts transactions - this stops the outage clock

phases.label: Redirect clients
phases.explain: Pointing the application endpoint at {dr}

phases.label: Repoint DAGs
phases.explain: {dr} becomes the global primary of every distributed AG

phases.label: Surviving forwarders
phases.explain: Forwarders outside {failedRegion} re-attach to {dr} and keep receiving changes

phases.label: Verify
phases.explain: Checking {dr} is primary, every database is online and writable

phases.label: Fence old primary
phases.explain: Blocking {primary} on the network first: it boots believing it is still primary

phases.label: Region back
phases.explain: Starting every VM in {failedRegion}

phases.label: Measure data loss
phases.explain: Comparing the last transaction on {primary} with what reached {dr}

phases.label: Drop stale copy
phases.explain: Preserving, then dropping the stale databases on {primary}

phases.label: Rejoin + seed
phases.explain: {primary} rejoins as a secondary of {dr} and is re-seeded

phases.label: Re-attach forwarders
phases.explain: Every forwarder synchronizes from the new global primary {dr}

phases.label: Lift fence
phases.explain: {primary} is a healthy secondary again - clients may connect

phases.label: Synchronize
phases.explain: Both replicas switch to synchronous commit so the swap loses nothing

phases.label: Role swap
phases.explain: {primary} becomes primary again, {dr} goes back to secondary

phases.label: Repoint DAGs
phases.explain: Every distributed AG follows the primary back to {failedRegion}

phases.label: Redirect + verify
phases.explain: Clients back to {primary}, write test

metrics.label: RTO
metrics.explain: Failure injected -> first write committed in {drRegion}

criteria.label: {dr} primary in {drRegion}, databases online and writable
Surviving forwarders keep synchronizing during the outage
Old primary fenced before power-on (no split-brain)
